warn.gave_up: decluttering-card-plus: gave up substituting variables after {passes} passes. Check whether a variable refers to itself.
warn.refused: decluttering-card-plus: left {which} in the card rather than substituting. {why}
warn.refused_transform: A transform only shapes text, so it needs a scalar value - applying one to a mapping or a list would garble its JSON. Give the variable a scalar value, or drop the transform.
warn.refused_resolver: A resolver reads its value as an entity id and asks Home Assistant, so it needs one that exists and carries what was asked for.
warn.refused_condition: An if: step keeps a value only while its condition holds. Add ? to drop the option when it does not, or a default: to show something in its place.
warn.refused_json: json turns the variable's own value into JSON text, so it has to come first in the chain. There is no step that turns text back into a mapping or a list.
warn.unresolved: decluttering-card-plus: {whose} uses {which}, which nothing gives a value to, so it is rendered as written. Set it on the card, or give it a default in the template. To write those brackets on purpose, escape it as [[{escape}]].
warn.no_item_template: decluttering-card-plus: {whose} uses {which}, but there is no item template called {names} here, so it is rendered as written. Check the name, that the template has an item: body rather than card:, and that it is in this dashboard's decluttering_templates.
warn.no_map_match: "{value}" matches none of the map: pairs
warn.refused_map: map: only gives a value for the pairs it names. Add *=something to catch every other value.
warn.unknown_step: decluttering-card-plus: {which} The placeholder is left in the card as written.
warn.unknown_step_one: {placeholder}: "{step}" is not a step this card knows.
warn.step_not_alone: {step} has to be the only step in its chain
warn.read_too_deep: decluttering-card-plus: {names} is built from other values more than {depth} deep, so it was used part-built. Shorten the chain of values it is made from.
warn.too_many_fills: more than {max} copies would be filled in across this card, so the rest are left
warn.not_a_list_source: {arg} is not a list or a registry source
warn.flat_after_repeat: flat only works straight after a repeat:
warn.condition_closed: its if: condition does not hold
warn.json_not_first: json can only be the first step
warn.override_misplaced: decluttering-card-plus: this card's {key}: block is ignored - the template "{template}" builds a {kind}, so only a {kind}: block is laid over it.
warn.tag_taken: decluttering-card-plus: <{tag}> is already registered by something else, skipping it.
